Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment involves two distinct MS applications: 1) Site-specific identification of UFMylation on RPL26 (using in-gel digestion of UFMylated bands) and 2) Cross-linking MS (XL-MS) using the DSBU crosslinker. While UFMylation is a distinct ubiquitin-like modification, it is mapped to the 'mod_sumo_qqtgg' logic in this ontology as the closest UBL-remnant/enrichment proxy, although the specific remnant here is valine-glycine (VG) rather than QQTGG. The search parameters explicitly include the VG dipeptide on Lysine.
